_comment: Hand-written routing rules for specific buildings, keyed by OSM id. Applied by scripts/build-data.mjs to the building and to every room inside it. 'doors' lists the door nodes a route must end at, per profile and per floor ('*' = any floor). 'roomLevelFromNumber' derives a room's floor from its number when OSM has no level tag: 1xx -> ground (0), 2xx -> level 1, 3xx -> level 2.
